title: Self-Aligned Forcing: Streaming Video Diffusion with Differentiable Noisy History
title_zh: 自对齐强迫：具有可微噪声历史的流式视频扩散

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive video diffusion enables interactive streaming generation, but suffers from error accumulation over long rollouts. Self-rollout training reduces exposure bias, yet finite rollouts leave long-range drift unresolved. We observe that the noise level of the history key-value (K/V) representations trades visual quality against motion, and that restoring gradients through the history aligns causal training far more closely with bidirectional training. Motivated by these observations, we introduce Self-Aligned Forcing ( SAF ), a training scheme that aligns the history of each block with the noise level of the block being denoised. Specifically, the history is the K/V produced by preceding blocks at the same denoising stage, so all blocks at a stage can be denoised in a single forward pass under a causal mask. This keeps the noisy history differentiable, allowing future losses to optimize how it is encoded. SAF therefore avoids a separate no-gradient rollout and per-block timestep-zero recaching, training up to 1.8 × 1.8\times faster than prior methods with lower memory. At inference, SAF achieves the highest single-GPU throughput among existing methods and keeps one history bank per stage for a multi-GPU pipeline, reaching 49.1 49.1 FPS on 4 GPUs. Experiments show superior long-horizon generation with a better balance between visual quality and motion. Project page: https://anonymous.4open.science/w/self-aligned-forcing/ .
paragraphs.zh: 自回归视频扩散模型支持交互式流式生成，但在长时间序列生成过程中存在误差累积问题。 自展开训练能够减少暴露偏差，但有限的展开长度仍无法解决长程漂移问题。 我们观察到，历史键值（K/V）表示的噪声水平在视觉质量与运动表现之间存在权衡，而通过历史恢复梯度则能使因果训练更紧密地契合双向训练。 基于这些观察，我们提出了自对齐强制（SAF）训练方案，该方案将每个块的历史与其正在去噪的块的噪声水平进行对齐。 具体而言，历史信息由前序块在同一去噪阶段生成的K/V组成，因此所有处于同一阶段的块都可以在单次前向传播中通过因果掩码完成去噪。 这使得含噪声的历史保持可微分性，从而允许后续损失函数优化其编码方式。 因此，SAF避免了单独进行无梯度展开和逐块时间步零缓存的重建过程，训练速度比先前方法快1.8倍（1.8×），且内存占用更低。 在推理阶段，SAF在现有方法中实现了单GPU最高的吞吐量，并为多GPU流水线保留了每个阶段一个历史库，在4块GPU上可达49.1 FPS。 实验表明，该方法在长时序生成任务中表现更优，并在视觉质量与运动表现之间实现了更好的平衡。 项目页面：https://anonymous.4open.science/w/self-aligned-forcing/ .

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion has emerged as a promising approach to interactive streaming video generation ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . It generates a video block by block, conditioning each new block on the key-value (K/V) representations of previously generated blocks, which form the history . The model can thus continuously extend a video and respond to new instructions without reprocessing the full sequence, as required by interactive applications such as game engines and world models ( Bruce et al., 2024 ; Valevski et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2025 ) . However, long-horizon streaming remains challenging, as it requires stability over videos much longer than the training clips, meaningful motion, and efficient generation.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归（AR）视频扩散模型已成为交互式流媒体视频生成的一种有前景的方法（Yin 等，2025；Huang 等，2025；Yang 等，2026）。 该模型以块为单位生成视频，每个新块的生成都以先前已生成块的关键值（K/V）表示为条件，这些表示共同构成了历史上下文。 因此，该模型能够持续扩展视频并响应新的指令，而无需重新处理整个序列，这恰好符合游戏引擎和世界模型等交互式应用的需求（Bruce 等，2024；Valevski 等，2025；He 等，2025）。 然而，长时程流媒体生成仍然充满挑战，因为它需要在远超训练片段长度的视频中保持稳定性，同时实现有意义的运动并保证高效的生成。

paragraphs.en: Long-horizon stability is limited mainly by error accumulation. Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) narrows the train–test gap, known as exposure bias ( Ranzato et al., 2016 ) , by training the model on its own generated history (Figure 1 a). Nevertheless, its finite rollouts do not fully account for errors accumulated over longer horizons. To improve robustness under limited training rollouts, recent methods build the history from partially denoised states. Rolling Forcing ( Liu et al., 2026 ) jointly denoises a rolling window with staggered noise levels, while HiAR ( Zou et al., 2026 ) takes the history one denoising step cleaner than the current block (Figure 1 b). HiAR further finds that aligning the history noise level with that of the current block minimizes error accumulation but lowers the overall VBench quality score ( Huang et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 长期稳定性主要受误差累积的限制。 自强制方法（Huang 等，2025）通过让模型在其自身生成的历史数据上进行训练（图 1a），缩小了训练与测试之间的差距，这一现象被称为暴露偏差（Ranzato 等，2016）。 然而，其有限的滚动执行无法完全解释在更长时间范围内累积的误差。 为了在有限的训练滚动执行下提升鲁棒性，近期方法采用部分去噪后的状态来构建历史数据。 滚动强制方法（Liu 等，2026）通过交错噪声水平对滚动窗口进行联合去噪，而 HiAR（Zou 等，2026）则使历史数据的去噪程度比当前区块高一个步骤（图 1b）。 HiAR 进一步发现，将历史数据的噪声水平与当前区块的噪声水平对齐，虽然能最小化误差累积，但也会降低整体的 VBench 质量分数（Huang 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: Observation 1. Noisy history not only reduces error accumulation but also increases motion dynamics, at the cost of imaging quality. Using a LongLive checkpoint trained with clean history, we vary only the history noise level t c t_{c} at inference. As shown in Figure 2(a) , sufficiently noisy history substantially increases the VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) dynamic degree, but imaging quality drops. The motion gain is notable, since models trained with distribution matching distillation (DMD) ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2024b ) commonly produce static outputs due to its mode-seeking objective ( Zou et al., 2026 ; You et al., 2026 ; Wu et al., 2026 ) . HiAR attributes reduced error accumulation to the lower signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of noisy history ( Zou et al., 2026 ) ; our observation suggests that this mechanism also underlies the motion gain and the quality loss. By weakening the constraint that the history imposes on the current block, lower SNR suppresses error propagation and increases motion dynamics, but also reduces temporal consistency and lowers imaging quality. The benefit and the cost thus share a single cause, yet the model cannot learn to balance them.
paragraphs.zh: 观察 1。 带有噪声的历史不仅减少了误差累积，还增强了运动动态性，但代价是成像质量下降。 使用通过干净历史训练的 LongLive 检查点，我们在推理时仅改变历史噪声水平 t c t_{c}。 如图 2(a) 所示，足够高的历史噪声会显著增加 VBench（Huang 等，2024）的动态程度，但成像质量会下降。 这种运动增益十分显著，因为通过分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）（Yin 等，2024a；Yin 等，2024b）训练的模型通常会产生静态输出，这是由其模式搜索目标所导致的（Zou 等，2026；You 等，2026；Wu 等，2026）。 HiAR 将误差累积的减少归因于带有噪声的历史更低的信噪比（SNR）（Zou 等，2026）；我们的观察表明，这一机制也是运动增益和画质下降的根本原因。 通过削弱历史对当前块施加的约束，较低的 SNR 会抑制误差传播并增强运动动态性，但也会降低时间一致性和成像质量。 因此，其益处和代价源于同一原因，但模型无法学会在两者之间取得平衡。

paragraphs.en: Observation 2. Detaching the history prevents the model from learning how to encode it for future blocks. Existing self-rollout methods detach the history K/V from gradient computation (Figure 1 a,b), as backpropagating through it would nest the computation graphs of all preceding blocks. Future losses therefore cannot optimize how preceding blocks are encoded for subsequent prediction. To quantify this effect, we compare the resulting parameter gradient with a matched-weight bidirectional reference, in which all blocks are processed jointly so that losses on later blocks also supervise earlier ones. With all other settings identical, restoring the gradient path through the history increases their cosine similarity from 0.643 0.643 to 0.972 0.972 (Figure 2(b) ). The gap is largest for the key projection W k W_{k} , whose cosine similarity drops to about 0.2 0.2 under detachment, indicating that the model barely learns to encode the history for future retrieval. Noisy history should therefore remain differentiable rather than serve only as fixed conditioning.
paragraphs.zh: 观察 2。 脱离历史会阻止模型学习如何将其编码以供后续模块使用。 现有的自我展开方法将历史键值对（K/V）与梯度计算分离（图 1a、b），因为通过历史进行反向传播会使所有前序模块的计算图嵌套在一起。 因此，未来的损失无法优化前序模块为后续预测所采用的编码方式。 为了量化这种影响，我们将所得到的参数梯度与一个匹配权重的双向参考进行比较，在该参考中，所有模块被联合处理，使得后续模块的损失也能对早期模块进行监督。 在其他所有设置完全相同的情况下，恢复通过历史的梯度路径可将它们的余弦相似度从 0.643 提升至 0.972（图 2(b)）。 这种差距在键投影 W_k 处最大；在脱离历史时，其余弦相似度会降至约 0.2，表明模型几乎无法学习如何为未来检索对历史进行编码。 因此，带有噪声的历史应当保持可微分性，而不应仅作为固定的条件输入。

paragraphs.en: Existing methods face a dilemma: noisy history is robust but detached, whereas differentiable history requires costly reconstruction. Self Gradient Forcing (SGF) ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) restores gradients through the history (Figure 1 c), but requires a separate no-gradient rollout to construct the history (similar to SDF in Figure 8 ). Moreover, its history is built from clean states, available only after a block is fully denoised and recached at timestep zero. This recaching adds a forward pass per block and prevents pipelining across denoising stages, limiting both training and inference efficiency.
paragraphs.zh: 现有方法面临一个两难困境：含噪声的历史虽然稳健但脱离实际，而可微分历史则需要耗费大量成本进行重建。 自我梯度强制（Self Gradient Forcing, SGF）（Zhuang 等人，2026）通过历史恢复梯度（图 1c），但需要一次独立的无梯度前向传播来构建历史（类似于图 8 中的 SDF）。 此外，其历史是基于干净状态构建的，而这些状态只有在某个块完全去噪并在时间步零重新缓存之后才能获得。 这种重新缓存为每个块增加了一次前向传播，并阻碍了不同去噪阶段之间的流水线处理，从而限制了训练和推理效率。

sents.en: Existing methods face a dilemma: noisy history is robust but detached, whereas differentiable history requires costly reconstruction.
sents.zh: 现有方法面临一个两难困境：含噪声的历史虽然稳健但脱离实际，而可微分历史则需要耗费大量成本进行重建。

sents.en: Self Gradient Forcing (SGF) ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) restores gradients through the history (Figure 1 c), but requires a separate no-gradient rollout to construct the history (similar to SDF in Figure 8 ).
sents.zh: 自我梯度强制（Self Gradient Forcing, SGF）（Zhuang 等人，2026）通过历史恢复梯度（图 1c），但需要一次独立的无梯度前向传播来构建历史（类似于图 8 中的 SDF）。

sents.en: Moreover, its history is built from clean states, available only after a block is fully denoised and recached at timestep zero.
sents.zh: 此外，其历史是基于干净状态构建的，而这些状态只有在某个块完全去噪并在时间步零重新缓存之后才能获得。

sents.en: This recaching adds a forward pass per block and prevents pipelining across denoising stages, limiting both training and inference efficiency.
sents.zh: 这种重新缓存为每个块增加了一次前向传播，并阻碍了不同去噪阶段之间的流水线处理，从而限制了训练和推理效率。

paragraphs.en: Our key insight is that stage alignment between the history and the current block makes noisy history differentiable efficiently without reconstruction. The history K/V is then exactly what preceding blocks compute while being denoised at the same stage. Since the history and the current block share one noise level, they can be processed in a single forward pass (Figures 1 d and 3 b), so the history is both noisy and differentiable without reconstruction. Besides, this causal training strategy shares the structure of bidirectional diffusion training, in which all blocks share one noise level and later blocks supervise earlier ones. Notably, this aligned setting lowers quality in HiAR, where the history is detached; once the history is learned, it achieves the highest Quality under every inference policy among the history schedules we study in training (Section 4.3 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们的核心见解是，历史与当前块之间的阶段对齐使得噪声历史无需重建即可被高效地微分。 此时，历史 K/V 正是前序块在同一阶段进行去噪时所计算的内容。 由于历史和当前块共享同一噪声水平，它们可以在单次前向传播中处理（图 1d 和图 3b），因此历史既保留噪声又可被微分，无需重建。 此外，这种因果训练策略与双向扩散训练的结构相似：所有块共享同一噪声水平，且后续块对早期块进行监督。 值得注意的是，这种对齐设置在 HiAR 中降低了质量，因为其中历史是分离的；一旦历史被学习，它在所有我们研究的训练历史调度方案中，于每种推理策略下都能达到最高的质量（第 4.3 节）。

paragraphs.en: Building on this insight, we propose Self-Aligned Forcing (SAF). SAF rolls out all blocks stage by stage: at each denoising step, a single block-causal forward pass processes every block, and gradients are taken at one randomly sampled stage under the standard DMD objective. Apart from a clean attention sink ( Xiao et al., 2024 ) recached within the same forward pass, it needs neither per-block recaching nor a separate no-gradient rollout, reducing training time and memory (Table 4 ). At inference, SAF can keep one history bank per noise level for a multi-GPU pipeline, or a single bank on one GPU to save memory (Figure 3 c). Our contributions are threefold:

paragraphs.en: We study how the history should be represented and reused in autoregressive video diffusion, showing that propagating gradients through noisy history K/V brings causal training close to bidirectional training, improving both overall quality and motion dynamics.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了在自回归视频扩散模型中应如何表示和复用历史，结果表明，通过含噪声的历史键值对（K/V）传播梯度，可使因果训练接近双向训练，从而提升整体质量和运动动态。

paragraphs.en: We propose SAF , which aligns the history noise level with the current block. All blocks are then rolled out in parallel within each stage, and gradients at a sampled stage can flow through the history. A clean sink anchors appearance at negligible cost, and per-stage history banks enable pipelined inference across GPUs.

paragraphs.en: Autoregressive Video Diffusion. Autoregressive video diffusion generates a video as causal temporal blocks, enabling streaming generation with a KV-cached history ( Sand AI et al., 2025 ; Lin et al., 2025 ; Kodaira et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ; Yi et al., 2026 ) . Diffusion Forcing ( Chen et al., 2024 ) assigns different noise levels to temporal tokens, CausVid ( Yin et al., 2025 ) distills a bidirectional model into a few-step causal generator, and LongLive ( Yang et al., 2026 ) scales this paradigm to real-time long videos with streaming long tuning, windowed attention, frame sinks, and KV recaching. To improve long-horizon robustness, Rolling Forcing ( Liu et al., 2026 ) jointly denoises a window at staggered noise levels, and HiAR ( Zou et al., 2026 ) denoises timestep-first and builds the history from intermediate denoising states. These methods change the noise level of the history but keep it detached, so losses on later blocks cannot optimize how it is encoded.
paragraphs.zh: 自回归视频扩散。 自回归视频扩散将视频生成为因果时间块，从而实现基于 KV 缓存历史记录的流式生成（Sand AI 等，2025；Lin 等，2025；Kodaira 等，2026；Lu 等，2026；Yi 等，2026）。 扩散强制法（Chen 等，2024）为时间令牌分配不同的噪声水平，CausVid（Yin 等，2025）将双向模型蒸馏为少数步骤的因果生成器，而 LongLive（Yang 等，2026）则通过流式长调优、窗口注意力、帧接收器和 KV 重新缓存，将该范式扩展至实时长视频。 为了提高长期生成的鲁棒性，滚动强制法（Liu 等，2026）以错开的噪声水平联合去噪一个窗口，而 HiAR（Zou 等，2026）则按时间步优先进行去噪，并从中间的去噪状态中构建历史记录。 这些方法改变了历史记录中的噪声水平，但使其保持独立，因此后续时间块的损失无法优化其编码方式。

paragraphs.en: Self-Generated Rollout and Cross-Block Credit Assignment. Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) trains the model on its own generated history to narrow the train–test gap, and Resampling Forcing ( Guo et al., 2026 ) and BAgger ( Po et al., 2026 ) further improve robustness through self-resampling and corrective rollout trajectories. All of them, however, detach the history K/V, so future losses cannot shape how earlier blocks are encoded. Live Avatar ( Huang et al., 2026a ) also matches the history timestep to the current block, yet its rollout remains serial and its history detached. Video-Mirai ( Yu et al., 2026 ) adds future-aware supervision through an auxiliary foresight pathway and feature distillation, whereas SGF ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) restores future-to-history gradients by re-encoding clean history built in a separate no-gradient rollout. Existing methods thus either detach the history, add auxiliary supervision, or require a separate no-gradient rollout, leaving efficient future-to-history optimization of noisy history K/V unresolved.
paragraphs.zh: 自生成展开与跨块信用分配。 自我强制（Huang 等，2025）通过让模型在其自身生成的历史数据上进行训练来缩小训练与测试之间的差距，而重采样强制（Guo 等，2026）和 BAgger（Po 等，2026）则通过自重采样和修正性展开轨迹进一步提升了模型的鲁棒性。 然而，这些方法都使历史 K/V 脱离当前处理流程，导致未来的损失无法影响早期块的编码方式。 Live Avatar（Huang 等，2026a）也将历史的时间步与当前块进行匹配，但其展开过程仍然是串行的，且历史数据是脱离的。 Video-Mirai（Yu 等，2026）通过一个辅助的前瞻路径和特征蒸馏加入了面向未来的监督机制，而 SGF（Zhuang 等，2026）则通过在无梯度展开中构建干净的历史并重新编码，恢复了从未来到历史的梯度。 因此，现有方法要么使历史脱离流程，要么添加辅助监督，要么需要独立的无梯度展开，从而未能解决对含噪声历史 K/V 的高效未来-历史优化问题。

paragraphs.en: SAF rests on a single design choice: at every denoising step, the history is taken at the same noise level as the current block. This choice makes the local history both noisy and differentiable without any reconstruction (Section 3.2 ) and allows self-rollout to proceed in parallel across blocks during training (Section 3.3 ). We complement it with a clean sink that anchors appearance over the whole video (Section 3.4 ), and at inference it yields per-stage history K/V banks that pipeline naturally across GPUs (Section 3.5 ). Figure 3 summarizes the framework.
paragraphs.zh: SAF 基于一个单一的设计决策：在每个去噪步骤中，历史信息都取自与当前块相同的噪声水平。 这一决策使得局部历史既包含噪声又可微分，而无需任何重建（第 3.2 节），并允许在训练期间跨块并行进行自我展开（第 3.3 节）。 我们辅以一个干净的“汇点”，用于在整个视频中锚定外观（第 3.4 节）；在推理阶段，它能生成各阶段的 K/V 历史银行，从而在各 GPU 之间自然地进行流水线处理（第 3.5 节）。 图 3 总结了该框架。

paragraphs.en: Our models are trained on 5-second, single-prompt video clips in both framewise and chunkwise settings, and we evaluate whether this short-horizon training transfers to longer and interactive generation. Specifically, three complementary benchmarks are used: VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) evaluates 5-second clips at the training horizon, Interactive ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Ji et al., 2025 ) generates 60-second videos across six 10-second segments, each conditioned on a distinct prompt, and MovieGen-100s ( Polyak et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) generates 100-second videos from 128 prompts to test generation quality at 20 × 20{\times} the training length. We compare with Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) , LongLive ( Yang et al., 2026 ) , Causal-Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) , HiAR ( Zou et al., 2026 ) , and SGF ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) , re-evaluating all of them with official weights under identical random seeds; only Causal-Forcing and SGF release framewise checkpoints. Additional protocol and scoring details are provided in Appendix C .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的模型在帧级和分块设置下，使用持续5秒的单提示视频片段进行训练，并评估这种短期训练能否迁移到更长且具备交互性的生成任务中。 具体而言，我们使用了三个互补的基准测试：VBench（Huang等，2024）评估训练时长范围内的5秒片段；Interactive（Yang等，2026；Ji等，2025）通过六个10秒的片段生成60秒的视频，每个片段均基于不同的提示词；MovieGen-100s（Polyak等，2025；Zhang等，2026）则利用128个提示词生成100秒的视频，以测试生成质量在训练时长20×20{\times}下的表现。 我们将模型与Self-Forcing（Huang等，2025）、LongLive（Yang等，2026）、Causal-Forcing（Zhu等，2026）、HiAR（Zou等，2026）和SGF（Zhuang等，2026）进行了比较，并使用官方权重在完全相同的随机种子下重新评估了所有模型；其中仅Causal-Forcing和SGF发布了帧级检查点。 补充的协议与评分细节见附录C。

paragraphs.en: Quantitative analysis. Table 1 reports the chunkwise comparison, where ours with SAF M leads nearly all aggregate metrics across short-video, interactive, and long-video generation. LongLive attains a higher Interactive ViCLIP score, plausibly reflecting its dedicated prompt-switching and long-video training, but ours still achieves higher Interactive Quality and MovieGen-100s Quality. The only remaining deficit is a small drop in VBench Semantic, a metric that often decreases when motion and dynamics are stronger. Ours is also the fastest single-GPU method because it avoids the extra timestep-zero forward pass required by clean-history recaching, and its stage-wise design enables four-GPU pipelined inference for a further throughput gain. SAF S is slightly weaker than SAF M due to its train–test mismatch, yet it remains competitive and preserves clear quality advantages. Full dimension-wise scores and the framewise comparison are provided in Appendix D .

paragraphs.en: Qualitative analysis. Figures 6 and 7 show that the chunkwise gains translate into stronger semantic alignment and visual stability. In Interactive generation, ours tracks successive prompt changes while preserving visual fidelity; in contrast, LongLive can introduce semantic errors such as duplicating the cat, and SGF fails to realize the requested prompt-conditioned motion. On MovieGen-100s, ours maintains the table-wiping motion and scene layout over the full horizon, whereas SGF duplicates the human subject and LongLive produces inconsistent background reflections. Additional comparisons, including framewise results, are provided in Appendix F , and more visualizations are provided in the supplementary material.
paragraphs.zh: 定性分析。 图6和图7表明，分块增益能够带来更强的语义对齐和视觉稳定性。 在交互式生成中，我们的方法能够追踪连续提示的变化，同时保持视觉保真度；相比之下，LongLive 可能会引入语义错误（例如重复生成猫），而 SGF 则无法实现根据提示要求的运动。 在 MovieGen-100s 数据集上，我们的方法在整个时间范围内保持了擦桌动作和场景布局，而 SGF 会重复生成人类主体，LongLive 则会生成不一致的背景反射。 更多比较结果（包括逐帧结果）见附录 F，更多可视化结果见补充材料。

paragraphs.en: We conduct ablations on 20-second subsets of MovieGen-100s and Interactive, with protocol details and full metrics reported in Appendix E . Table 3 shows consistent trends for both SAF M and SAF S . Detaching the history K/V mildly reduces Quality but substantially lowers Dynamic Degree, confirming the importance of the write term, i.e., future-to-history supervision. Removing sink recaching causes the largest degradation in both metrics. For single-bank inference under Fixed t t , a larger t t generally improves Quality and Dynamic Degree, but reduces Motion Smoothness and Imaging Quality, revealing a trade-off between dynamics and visual stability. We therefore adopt the Mix policy for SAF S , which provides a more balanced operating point across dynamics, smoothness, and image fidelity.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MovieGen-100s 和 Interactive 数据集的 20 秒子集上进行了消融实验，具体协议细节和完整指标报告见附录 E。 表 3 显示，SAF M 和 SAF S 均呈现出一致的趋势。 断开历史 K/V 会轻微降低质量，但会显著降低动态程度，这证实了写入项的重要性，即从未来到历史的监督作用。 移除 sink recaching 会导致两项指标出现最严重的性能下降。 在 Fixed t t 下的单银行推理中，较大的 t t 通常能提升质量和动态程度，但会降低动作流畅度和成像质量，揭示了动态性与视觉稳定性之间的权衡关系。 因此，我们为 SAF S 采用了混合策略，该策略在动态性、流畅度和图像保真度之间提供了更均衡的运行点。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we show that history K/V along the denoising trajectory, when aligned with the current noise level, can serve as an effective and trainable memory for streaming video diffusion. SAF realizes this by aligning each block’s history with its denoising stage and rolling out all blocks at each stage in a single causal forward pass. This keeps the noisy history differentiable, allowing future losses to supervise how it is written, while avoiding both a separate no-gradient rollout to construct the history and per-block timestep-zero recaching. Empirically, SAF improves long-horizon generation and prompt switching, accelerates training by up to 1.8 × 1.8\times over SGF with lower memory, and supports efficient multi-GPU pipelined inference. Its noisy local history can still cause abrupt changes when new content enters the frame under camera motion (Appendix G ). Overall, our results suggest that optimizing history directly along the denoising trajectory is a promising path toward efficient, long-horizon, and interactive video generation.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们证明了沿着去噪轨迹的历史 K/V 值，在与当前噪声水平对齐时，可以作为流式视频扩散模型中一种有效且可训练的记忆机制。 SAF 通过将每个块的历史与其去噪阶段对齐，并在每个阶段以单次因果前向传播的方式展开所有块来实现这一点。 这使得噪声历史保持可微分性，从而允许未来的损失函数监督其写入过程，同时避免了为构建历史而进行的独立无梯度展开以及每个块的零时刻缓存重新加载。 实验表明，SAF 能够提升长时程生成和提示切换效果，与 SGF 相比，在更低的内存占用下将训练速度提升了最多 1.8 × 1.8 倍，并支持高效的跨多 GPU 的流水线推理。 然而，在相机运动导致新内容进入画面时，其噪声局部历史仍可能引发突变（附录 G）。 总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，直接沿着去噪轨迹优化历史，是迈向高效、长时程且具备交互能力的视频生成的一条有前景的路径。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 runs SAF M on one GPU by denoising each block through all S S stages before starting the next. It respects the same dependencies as the pipeline of Algorithm 5 , so both produce identical videos from the same noise: when block i i reaches stage s s , bank ℋ ( s ) \mathcal{H}^{(s)} holds exactly its history ℋ i ( s ) \mathcal{H}_{i}^{(s)} .
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 通过在所有 S 个阶段对每个块进行去噪，然后才开始下一个阶段，从而在单个 GPU 上运行 SAF M。 它与算法 5 的管道遵循相同的依赖关系，因此两者从相同的噪声中都能生成完全相同的视频：当块 i 到达阶段 s 时，银行 ℋ ( s ) 恰好包含其历史 ℋ i ( s )。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 3 implements the two passes of Appendix A ; score-model updates follow the standard DMD procedure. A context-stage plan { c j } ∼ π ( ⋅ ∣ d ) \{c_{j}\}\sim\pi(\cdot\mid d) , drawn according to Eq. 7 , is shared by both passes. paragraphs.en: The generator is a causal Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B ( Wan et al., 2025 ) trained with DMD ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ) . Wan2.1-T2V-14B serves as the real score model with a classifier-free guidance ( Ho and Salimans, 2022 ) scale of 3.0 3.0 , and the bidirectional Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B serves as the fake score model. Following SGF ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) , we initialize SAF and SDF from the ar_diffusion checkpoint released by Causal-Forcing ( Zhu et al., 2026 ) . Training uses text prompts only, taken from the VidProM prompts ( Wang and Yang, 2024 ) as filtered and extended by Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) . Each training sample has 21 latent frames, corresponding to a 5-second video at 832 × 480 , 16 832\times 480,16 FPS. All models use S = 4 S=4 denoising stages with noise levels ( t 1 , … , t 4 ) = ( 1000,750,500,250 ) (t_{1},\ldots,t_{4})=(1000,750,500,250) and a timestep shift of 5 5 .
paragraphs.zh: 该生成器是一个因果 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B（Wan 等，2025），使用 DMD（Yin 等，2024b；Yin 等，2024a）进行训练。 Wan2.1-T2V-14B 作为真实得分模型，采用无分类器引导（Ho 和 Salimans，2022），其引导尺度为 3.0 3.0；而双向 Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B 则作为虚假得分模型。 遵循 SGF（Zhuang 等，2026）的方法，我们从 Causal-Forcing（Zhu 等，2026）发布的 ar_diffusion 检查点中初始化 SAF 和 SDF。 训练仅使用文本提示，这些提示来自 VidProM 提示集（Wang 和 Yang，2024），并由 Self-Forcing（Huang 等，2025）进行了筛选和扩展。 每个训练样本包含 21 个潜在帧，对应于分辨率为 832 × 480、帧率为 16 832\times 480,16 FPS 的 5 秒视频。 所有模型均使用 S = 4 S=4 个去噪阶段，噪声水平为 (t_{1},\ldots,t_{4})=(1000,750,500,250)，时间步长偏移量为 5 5。

paragraphs.en: In the chunkwise setting, each block contains 3 latent frames, and the local attention window spans 12 latent frames, including the current block and a 3-frame sink. In the framewise setting, each block contains 1 latent frame, and the window spans 21 latent frames with a 4-frame sink, following SGF ( Zhuang et al., 2026 ) . The window works as a first-in, first-out queue, except for the sink, which stays fixed. The sink holds the latent frames at the start of the video and is recached at timestep zero from a single estimate, taken at the exit stage during training and at the final stage at inference, whereas the rest of the history keeps the noisy K/V from the denoising trajectory (Appendix B ).
paragraphs.zh: 在分块设置中，每个块包含 3 个潜在帧，局部注意力窗口覆盖 12 个潜在帧，包括当前块和一个 3 帧的缓冲区。 在逐帧设置中，每个块包含 1 个潜在帧，窗口覆盖 21 个潜在帧，并包含一个 4 帧的缓冲区，遵循 SGF（Zhuang 等人，2026）。 该窗口充当先进先出队列，但缓冲区除外，其位置保持固定。 缓冲区存储视频开始时的潜在帧，并在时间步零时通过单次估计重新获取；该估计在训练期间于输出阶段取得，在推理时则于最终阶段取得，而历史中的其余部分则保留去噪轨迹中的噪声 K/V（附录 B）。

paragraphs.en: We use AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2019 ) with ( β 1 , β 2 ) = ( 0 , 0.999 ) (\beta_{1},\beta_{2})=(0,0.999) and a weight decay of 0.01 0.01 . The learning rate is 2 × 10 − 6 2\times 10^{-6} for the generator and 4 × 10 − 7 4\times 10^{-7} for the fake score model. The fake score model is first warmed up for 10 updates, after which the generator is updated once every 5 fake score updates. We train for 800 steps on 8 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs with a batch size of 4 per GPU (32 in total) and a random seed of 42 42 . Starting at step 200, we also track an exponential moving average (EMA) of the generator weights with a decay of 0.99 0.99 .

paragraphs.en: All three benchmarks follow existing evaluation protocols. On VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ; Huang et al., 2026b ) , we generate five videos for each of the 944 unique standard prompts and report the Total, Quality, and Semantic scores. Interactive uses the 100 prompt sequences released by MemFlow ( Ji et al., 2025 ) and the protocol of LongLive ( Yang et al., 2026 ) . Each 60-second video is generated from six prompts in turn, one for every 10 seconds. Prompt alignment is the ViCLIP ( Wang et al., 2024 ) similarity between each 10-second segment and its own prompt, averaged over the six segments. MovieGen-100s uses the 128 extended MovieGen ( Polyak et al., 2025 ) prompts released by UniTemp ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) and generates one 100-second video per prompt. On Interactive and MovieGen-100s, Quality is computed with VBench-Long ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , which splits each video into 2-second clips and scores them on the same seven quality dimensions as VBench. All per-dimension scores in the tables are multiplied by 100 100 .

paragraphs.en: On a single GPU, SAF M needs more memory than SAF S because it stores one K/V bank per denoising stage. With pipelined inference (Algorithm 5 ), however, each GPU holds only the bank of its own stage, so the per-GPU memory is close to that of SAF S . SAF S saves memory by letting all stages read the same bank, which departs from the stage-aligned history used in training and allows errors to accumulate over long rollouts. The effect is minor in the chunkwise setting but more visible in the framewise setting, where single-frame blocks and a 21-frame window keep more of this history in context (Tables 1 and 6 ). We therefore recommend SAF M with multi-GPU pipelined inference. SAF M can also run on a single H100 GPU, so SAF S is only needed when GPU memory is limited.
paragraphs.zh: 在单 GPU 上，SAF M 比 SAF S 需要更多内存，因为它为每个降噪阶段存储一个 K/V 银行。 然而，通过流水线推理（算法 5），每个 GPU 仅保留自身阶段的银行，因此每个 GPU 的内存使用量接近于 SAF S。 SAF S 通过让所有阶段读取相同的银行来节省内存，这与训练时使用的按阶段对齐的历史记录不同，并可能导致长时间推理过程中错误累积。 在分块设置中，这种影响较小，但在逐帧设置中更为明显，因为单帧块和 21 帧窗口会在上下文中保留更多此类历史记录（表 1 和表 6）。 因此，我们推荐使用多 GPU 流水线推理的 SAF M。 SAF M 也可以在单 H100 GPU 上运行，因此只有在 GPU 内存有限时才需要使用 SAF S。

paragraphs.en: We still observe inconsistent changes in two situations. When the camera moves, content newly entering at the frame boundary can change abruptly across frames, because the model can only refer to noisy K/V in the local window, and nothing outside the window except the sink is kept. At prompt switches, since SAF is trained only on single-prompt clips, changing the action is handled smoothly, but introducing new objects, scenes, or characters can make the appearance unstable, as the sink contains none of this content. Selectively retaining informative K/V beyond the window and training with prompt switches may address these two cases, which we leave to future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们仍然观察到两种情况下的不一致变化。 当摄像头移动时，新进入画面边界的内容可能在不同帧之间突然改变，因为模型只能参考局部窗口内的噪声 K/V，而窗口外部除了 sink 之外没有任何内容被保留。 在提示词切换时，由于 SAF 仅在单提示词片段上进行训练，因此动作的变化能够被平稳处理，但引入新物体、场景或角色会导致外观不稳定，因为 sink 中不包含这些内容。 选择性地保留窗口之外的信息性 K/V，并通过提示词切换进行训练，或许可以解决这两种情况，但这将留待未来的工作。

sents.zh: 我们仍然观察到两种情况下的不一致变化。

sents.en: When the camera moves, content newly entering at the frame boundary can change abruptly across frames, because the model can only refer to noisy K/V in the local window, and nothing outside the window except the sink is kept.
sents.zh: 当摄像头移动时，新进入画面边界的内容可能在不同帧之间突然改变，因为模型只能参考局部窗口内的噪声 K/V，而窗口外部除了 sink 之外没有任何内容被保留。

sents.en: At prompt switches, since SAF is trained only on single-prompt clips, changing the action is handled smoothly, but introducing new objects, scenes, or characters can make the appearance unstable, as the sink contains none of this content.
sents.zh: 在提示词切换时，由于 SAF 仅在单提示词片段上进行训练，因此动作的变化能够被平稳处理，但引入新物体、场景或角色会导致外观不稳定，因为 sink 中不包含这些内容。

sents.en: Selectively retaining informative K/V beyond the window and training with prompt switches may address these two cases, which we leave to future work.
sents.zh: 选择性地保留窗口之外的信息性 K/V，并通过提示词切换进行训练，或许可以解决这两种情况，但这将留待未来的工作。
